_comment: GDPR Art. 22 automated decision-making register for the Art. 15 access report. Edit this file directly (via PR) to add, remove, or reword entries — no code change needed. Each entry's `statement` and `safeguards_text` are shown to the reviewer as pre-approved subject-facing text and inserted verbatim into the generated report if selected. Every entry must be validated by the organisation's DPO/legal counsel against what the named system actually does before use — see docs/sar-app.md's 'Automated decision-making' section.

systems.human_review_exists: None — the premium is calculated and offered without human review.
systems.statement: We use automated processing to calculate your premium, taking into account factors such as your claims history, the type of cover selected, and risk characteristics associated with you and the insured item. This directly determines the price you are offered.
systems.safeguards_text: You have the right to request a manual review of this pricing decision, to express your view on the factors used, and to contest the outcome.

systems.human_review_exists: None for routine adjustments — a person can review on request.
systems.statement: Where you participate in a telematics or usage-based programme, automated processing analyses driving behaviour — such as speed, braking, and time of travel — to adjust your premium on an ongoing basis. This can increase or decrease the price you pay.
systems.safeguards_text: You have the right to query a specific pricing adjustment, request the underlying scoring factors be reviewed by a person, and opt out of the programme in favour of standard pricing.

systems.human_review_exists: REPLACE ME — confirm whether every outcome is reviewed, or only referrals/declines, before using this entry.
systems.statement: Automated processing assesses risk factors from your application to produce a recommended underwriting outcome (accept, decline, or refer for further review). [State here whether a human underwriter reviews every outcome, or only referred/declined cases.]
systems.safeguards_text: You have the right to request human review of a decline or referral, to provide additional context, and to contest the outcome.

systems.human_review_exists: A specialist investigator reviews before any adverse decision is made — confirm this holds for every case before using this entry.
systems.statement: When you submit a claim, automated processing scores it against known fraud indicators to prioritise investigation. A high score routes your claim to a specialist investigator for human review before any decision is made; it does not by itself determine the outcome of your claim.
systems.safeguards_text: Since a person reviews before any adverse decision, Art. 22 does not strictly apply — confirm this is factually true for every case before using this framing.

systems.human_review_exists: None for claims within the automated criteria — a claims handler reviews everything outside them.
systems.statement: Straightforward claims below [threshold] and meeting defined criteria are settled automatically without individual human review, using processing that checks policy cover, claim value, and supporting evidence against our claims rules. Claims outside these criteria are reviewed by a claims handler.
systems.safeguards_text: You have the right to request the automated settlement be reviewed by a claims handler, to express your view, and to contest the outcome.

systems.human_review_exists: None — a person can review on request.
systems.statement: At renewal, automated processing recalculates your risk profile using updated claims and policy data to determine your renewal premium. This can result in a different price than your previous term.
systems.safeguards_text: You have the right to request a manual review of your renewal price and to contest the recalculated risk profile.

systems.human_review_exists: None — a person can review on request.
systems.statement: If you choose to pay by instalments, automated processing assesses affordability using information such as payment history to decide whether instalment terms can be offered, and on what terms. This can affect whether instalments are available to you and the terms offered.
systems.safeguards_text: You have the right to request human review of an affordability decision and to contest the outcome.
